rationale: C01 plausibly supplied a material resignation-letter template: acceptance of an official's departure, praise of his contribution and agency leadership, reference to returning to private life, best wishes, and the same warm-regard closing. C09 is substantively closer because it concerns resignation from the predecessor mobilization office, but its wording and closing structure are less closely aligned. C13 concerns Hoegh himself and supplies closely related civil-defense subject matter, yet it is an appointment/transition letter rather than the clearest drafting model for the later resignation letter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As I accept your resignation, effective January 20, 1961, I assure you of the Nation's debt to you for your personal contribution.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have no alternative but to accept it as you requested... You have made a unique contribution to the labors of this Administration
shared_material.explanation: Both open the substantive portion by accepting the resignation and immediately characterizing the official's contribution.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I was particularly pleased to note in your report that... These are some of the outstanding achievements for which you deserve the grateful thanks of the Nation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have been pleased with the manner in which the Council of Economic Advisers, under your leadership, has been re-established as a vital center... ample evidence of your work in this regard.
shared_material.explanation: Both develop the praise through concrete institutional achievements under the departing official's leadership.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You have my very best wishes as you return to private life... With warm regard
shared_material.parent_excerpt: My best wishes accompany you as you return to private life... With warm personal regard
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive exit formula and nearly identical closing provide strong literal evidence of reuse.
